command: import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';import{verifyArtifacts}from'./scripts/ci/artifacts.mjs';import{sourceFingerprint}from'./scripts/documentation-lib.mjs';const base='.local/rule-02/hosted-rule-01';const run=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'/run.json'));const jobs=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'/jobs.json'));const artifact=verifyArtifacts(base+'/artifacts');const pipeline=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'/artifacts/pipeline.json'));if(run.status!=='completed'||run.conclusion!=='success'||jobs.jobs.some(j=>j.conclusion!=='success')||artifact.identity.source_commit!==run.head_sha||artifact.identity.source_fingerprint!==sourceFingerprint()||pipeline.result!=='passed')throw Error('Hosted result/source mismatch');console.log(JSON.stringify({run:{id:run.id,url:run.html_url,sha:run.head_sha,conclusion:run.conclusion,created_at:run.created_at,updated_at:run.updated_at},jobs:jobs.jobs.map(j=>({id:j.id,started_at:j.started_at,completed_at:j.completed_at,conclusion:j.conclusion})),identity:artifact.identity,files:artifact.files.length,stages:pipeline.stages},null,2));console.log('PASS completed RULE-01 hosted run and downloaded artifact identity; remote times are GitHub-reported, this receipt times local verification');
summary: Verify completed RULE-01 hosted CI and downloaded artifact against merged source; local verification of remote evidence
